componentRules.primaryButton: Full-width pill, 56px tall, radius 28, ultraviolet #5A32D6 fill, white Anonymous Pro 700 ALL CAPS 15px, letter-spacing 0.08em. Every primary button in the app is this purple.
componentRules.secondaryButton: White or transparent pill with a 2px ink or ultraviolet outline.
componentRules.selectedState: 2px DASHED lilac #BE8EF5 border with lavenderPale #F3EEFF fill. Used for the chosen pen, date type, recipient, send-time and any other picked option. Unselected: white fill, 1.5px #E3DCF2 border.
componentRules.card: White, 1.5px #E3DCF2 border, radius 18. Grouped form fields live in one card with 1.5px #EEEAF5 dividers; each row has a 13px #4A4163 label above a 16px field.
componentRules.toggleSwitch: 52x32, 1.5px ink border; off = #E3DCF2 track, on = lime #C6FF3D track; white knob with ink border.
componentRules.pillTag: 13px bold, radius 10, padding 3x9. Lime for urgent or positive (Tomorrow, In 5 days, Available, Verified); lavender for later.
componentRules.stamp: The SEND stamp look: stampFrame #EEE8FB fill, 4px dashed ultraviolet border, ultraviolet center, lime heart, white wave lines.
componentRules.limeUsage: Small accents only (pills, badges, switch on, the stamp heart). Never headings.

font.display: Unbounded 400 (600 only for initials inside the heart)

penFonts.Your handwriting: the user's own handwriting font (stand-in in the mockups: Nothing You Could Do)

notebookPaper.background: paper #FBF8F2 with a 1px #E7E1EF line every 36px, drawn as ONE continuous background behind the whole screen (including behind the tab bar), never per section.
notebookPaper.titleBand: The top of every screen is a clear band with no lines. Its height is always a multiple of 36 (144, 216, 252, 288 or 324) so the lines below stay on the 36px rhythm. A 2px #D9CFEC rule marks the bottom of the band. Titles are vertically centered in the band below the status bar (top padding 54).
notebookPaper.cards: White cards sit on top of the lines and hide them.
